info.title: Authorization
info.description:
**

Suomi.fi Authorization related endpoints to be used with Vero APIs

** The Sandbox API documentation is provided for preview purposes only. Endpoints might not be final and might be proof of concepts or under development and data content can change. Each sandbox endpoint has a documentation tag indicating endpoint status. Endpoint can be a proof of concept, in development or already in production. Test data mentioned in the endpoint documentation refers to data in the Vero API test environment and does not apply to the sandbox. Calling sandbox interfaces requires an api key (header Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key) from the Sandbox. Calling the interfaces in actual testing and production environments requires a valid client certificate from the Tax Administration's certificate service and an application-specific API key (header vero-softwarekey) from the Vero API Portal. Last updated 2026-09-07
